priority_window.rule: Until the D1 freeze (2026-11-04 23:59 PT), the d1-studysprint chain (slate iterations · releases · snapshot · deploys on its path) holds FIRST CLAIM on runner supply. Admission and sweeps treat chain runs as the highest claim; non-chain tier-3 and tier-4 work YIELDS — deferred by admission where the evaluator reaches it, and first in line for supersede sweeps — per the hold/sweep doctrine. Tiers 1–2 keep their standing rules; the window adds the chain's claim above them for D1 chain nodes only.
